parole.significato: to shear (to remove the fleece of sheep)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Spanish esquilar (“to shear”), from Old Spanish esquirar, from Gothic *𐍃𐌺𐌰𐌹𐍂𐌰𐌽 (*skairan), from Proto-Germanic *skeraną. Cognate with English shear.

parole.significato: excessive pride, especially of one's nation; uncritical, unconditional patriotism
parole.testo: Borrowed from Spanish ufanismo, from ufano (“proud”). Of uncertain origin; perhaps from Gothic 𐌿𐍆𐌾𐍉 (ufjō).
Borrowed from Spanish ufano, possibly from Gothic 𐌿𐍆𐌾𐍉 (ufjō). Compare Catalan ufana.
